source_identity.canonical_title: L'engagement féministe est une tâche trop grande et mène au burn-out militant

translation.canonical_title: Feminist activism is too great a task and leads to activist burnout
translation.displayed_title: Feminist activism is too great a task and leads to activist burn-out
translation.summary: Several women describe how this commitment put their lives on hold. A lifelong struggle, time-consuming and exhausting. This is known as activist burnout. The scale of the phenomenon even prompted the hashtag #PayeTonBurnOutMilitant. The activists affected describe exhaustion, and some mention post-traumatic stress, or vicarious trauma, among certain social workers and helping professionals. Faced with a flood of testimonies, they experience victims' distress vicariously. Some feel they are "doing the state's job" by being involved throughout the support process: taking people in, comforting them, and assisting with legal proceedings... Some give up and return to a quieter, more conventional life, regarding the struggle as disproportionate and lost in advance.

citations.translated_citation: I am no longer, or perhaps never was, strong enough; I am exhausted and, honestly, terrified [...] I can no longer read your testimonies and process them on top of the violence I experience whenever I step outside. The anger I have accumulated over almost seven years is eating me alive and drives me to react almost systematically, and most of the time it only makes the situation worse.
